title: Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo Saishuu Sankan Hatsubai Kinen Special PV
content:
As a casual and anime only jjk fan, I’m probably the wrong person to sell you out this preview, I’ll even say it straight. I have no idea what I watched, nor how to relate it into the series, but maybe that’s the the best.

If your not a Manga fan then you’re most definitely gonna stare at the screen for 30 seconds and retain no recollection to what was shown, but at least, it is a reassurance that whatever is coming will have heavenly animation quality. So gritty and dark it might as well be a documentary.

Overall: 7.76/10.
